messages:
erin: Quick design review — compact credentials list v3 in Figma. Link: https://figma.com/file/def/cred-v3
cole: Looks tighter. How do users rotate keys without expanding rows? I don't want extra clicks.
maya: Proposed: a single kebab with keyboard focusable actions. But that hides actions from screen readers if not labelled well.
tom: Make the kebab a real button with aria-haspopup and a clear aria-label like 'Row actions for <credential name>'. That should be keyboard accessible.
a11y-bot: Accessibility reminder: action buttons must have visible focus and at least 44px touch target on mobile. Ensure color is not the only indicator of dangerous actions.
erin: Microcopy question: for rotate confirmation, current text "Rotate key now?" feels terse. Suggest: "Rotate credential now. The current token will stop working immediately"
cole: For revoke, prefer 'Disable access' as user-facing wording. Add a small info line: 'Existing sessions may continue until token expiry.'
maya: Empty state: include two starter recipes: 'Service token — CI/CD' and 'Dev token — local testing' with one-line descriptions. Helps reduce support tickets.
tom: After create, focus should move to the new token card and automatically focus the copy button. Also announce 'Token created. Press Enter to copy.' via aria-live.
\a11y-bot: Checklist: aria-live for copy/revoke, labeled reveal toggle (e.g., 'Show token value'), keyboard operable menus, contrast checks for danger buttons.
erin: Thanks — I'll update the mock with labelled kebab, recipe cards, and refined copy. Will post a follow-up with the new flows.
